summary: Iteration 27 (Message-469 backlog) verified: Timezone preferences (manual override + invalid rejection + session persistence), Analytics date-range (days legacy + start/end + CSV export), and Frontend UI (Analytics DateFilter presets/custom, Leads date-filter with All-time, Settings tz suggestion banner + tz select, Signatures install with Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail tabs and 3 action buttons). All backend tests pass (7/7). All frontend testids present with no console errors.

issues: tz-suggest-dismiss ('Not now') is only stored in component state (setTzDismissed); banner reappears after a page reload. If UX intent is 'one-time' suggestion, persist dismissal in localStorage or user preferences.

action_items: (Minor/optional) Persist tz-suggestion dismissal (localStorage per user id) so the banner does not reappear on reload for users who chose 'Not now'.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /account/preferences correctly validates IANA tz via zoneinfo and sets timezone_source='manual'. No way to reset timezone_source via API (had to unset via mongo for demo flow); consider adding an admin/dev-only endpoint or ignoring 'source' when the payload is auto-detected on register.
_compute_overview accepts both days and start/end — good backwards compat; verified sub-range view counts are <= parent range.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only mutated work@gmail.com.timezone; reset to America/New_York via API and unset timezone_source via mongo shell so the tz-suggestion flow remains demonstrable (verified: banner returns on /settings after reload).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Message-469 features verified end-to-end. work@gmail.com timezone reset to America/New_York with timezone_source unset (banner will show).
